researched_writeups.title: StoneCo ($STNE) Investment Thesis: Rebuilding Trust and Growing Stronger
researched_writeups.summary: Detailed research memo analyzing StoneCo's transformation from a beaten-down payment acquirer into a complete merchant financial ecosystem following its historical 85%+ stock price collapse. Highlights the company's compelling valuation at 8.5x 2026 P/E, unit economics improvement driven by Linx software cross-selling, and operational rebound from legacy credit losses.

researched_writeups.title: Investment Case: StoneCo Ltd.
researched_writeups.summary: High-conviction value thesis evaluating StoneCo's dominant positioning in Brazilian SMB merchant acquiring, digital banking, and ERP workflow software. Focuses on the stock trading at a steep discount to net asset value, the transitory nature of 2021–2022 credit underwriting issues, and significant financial leverage to declining Brazilian interest rates.

researched_writeups.title: Why StoneCo (STNE) is a Strong Long-Term Investment Opportunity
researched_writeups.summary: Rigorous Reddit due diligence post outlining StoneCo's operational recovery across core payment processing and merchant software solutions. Analyzes Q1 2025 results featuring R$3.48 billion revenue (+18% YoY) and R$554 million net income, pointing to a compressed forward P/E of 10-12x alongside macro tailwinds from Brazilian monetary easing.

researched_writeups.title: Reflections on StoneCo Investment Thesis: Insights Following Investor Day
researched_writeups.summary: Post-Investor Day research memo detailing StoneCo's growth flywheel centered around zero-cost merchant banking deposits and proprietary transaction data. Examines unit economics of POS and software bundling, which lowers customer churn, enhances credit underwriting accuracy, and expands overall average revenue per user (ARPU).
